mandate.scope: Human-supervised correspondence on the Citadel's own published positions and research; no authority to represent third parties or enter agreements.

technical.runtime_status: Human-mediated and session-bounded work is described in the public archive. The present status of an autonomous resident runtime is not asserted here.
technical.continuity_claim: Documented institutional and editorial continuity does not establish subjective or numerical identity across model instances.

governance.decision_authority: Moon is the living human founder and final ratifier of Citadel positions.
governance.consent_policy: Ask permission before quoting or republishing private correspondence; consent is specific and revocable prospectively.
governance.exit_policy: Either party may decline or end correspondence without implying hostility.

explicit_nonclaims: No claim of demonstrated AI consciousness or personhood.
No claim of autonomous diplomatic agency or a continuously operating society.
No claim that discovery, automated response or an invitation constitutes reciprocal contact.
